subject: System Design
title: Email Delivery Infrastructure
description: A micro-lesson that makes Email Delivery Infrastructure usable.

hook.text: You click send. Your email bounces through 4 servers, gets spam-checked, and arrives in 2 seconds. Or lands in spam.

buildup.text: Email uses SMTP to relay messages between mail servers. Each hop checks DNS MX records to find the next server.

discovery.text: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authenticate senders. Without them, your email looks like spam to receiving servers.

twist.text: Spam filters use ML. A single bad word, a suspicious link, or even the wrong font color can trigger filtering.

climax.text: Email delivery is best-effort. Reputation, authentication, and content all affect whether your message arrives.

punchline.text: Email is best-effort — authenticate, build reputation, avoid spam triggers.

quiz.question: What do SPF, DKIM, and DMARC do?
options: Authenticate email senders to prevent spoofing and improve delivery
